messages:
Asha (People Ops): Heads-up: Zoe is converting from contractor -> full-time Mon. Putting the manager+HR checklist here so we can close preboard tonight. Keep replies short.

Preboard (today):
- Confirm legal name + preferred display name for payroll (Mira).
- Check existing contractor access scopes; decide what to keep vs revoke (Ben + Jordan).
- Equity docs + offer acceptance routed to HR (Mira).
- Device: Jordan confirm whether contractor laptop stays or new device issued.
- Calendar: 1:1 series, team kickoff, onboarding backlog review, 30/60/90 planning slot.
- Add Zoe to #eng, #product, and FT-only channels; flag any confidential channels to keep restricted.

Day 1 (low-noise):
- 09:30: HR + conversion paperwork (Mira).
- 11:00: Team intro & conversion announcement (Ben)  short, 10m.
- 13:00: Role alignment + ownerable priorities (Ben)  set top 3 30d outcomes.
- 15:00: Systems & permissions handoff (Jordan)  review what changes from contractor access.

Week 1 goals:
- Confirm payroll + benefits enrolled.
- Security training + SSO/MFA transition complete.
- Draft 1-page "transition notes": differences observed between contract and FT workflow; propose 2 process changes.

30/60/90 (copy into 1:1):
- 30d: Full product/context ramp, own one sprint's worth of tickets, confirm FT KPIs.
- 60d: Lead a cross-team ticket and present impact measurement.
- 90d: Drive hiring/coverage recommendations if workload indicates.

Logistics & notes:
- Equity onboarding link: https://hr.redwood.local/equity (Mira)
- If contractor laptop is kept, IT will reimage and rotate keys (Jordan).
- OnboardBot checklist ID OB-2107776665 created.

Ben (Hiring Manager): I'll send the conversion announcement and block 30m on day 2 to co-create the 30/60/90. Zoe, can you upload your preferred name + emergency contact to HR tonight?

Zoe (incoming, contractor->FT): On it, uploading now. Quick Q: will my calendar still show contractor meetings?

Jordan (IT): We will keep calendar invites but update attendee role. Reimaging laptop unless Zoe prefers new device; courier available. Need GitHub handle for team mapping.

Mira (HR): I routed equity docs. Zoe, expect a DocuSign invite and benefits enrollment email — please complete within 5 business days to avoid delays.

OnboardBot: Checklist OB-2107776665 created and reminders scheduled for day 3 and day 7: https://onboard.redwood.local/checklist/OB-2107776665

Ben (Hiring Manager): Thx all. If no blockers tonight we'll close preboard. :rocket:
